page_title: BOU 4-3 LUT | Bournemouth v Luton 13/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+9' The resulting free kick from Alfie Doughty (Luton) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
90+9' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Samuel Allison blows his whistle for a foul. Luton get a free kick.
90+8' What a sweet touch by Enes Unal (Bournemouth) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Thomas Kaminski to hold.
90+7' Reece Burke (Luton) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+6' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Ryan Christie and he is replaced by James Hill (Bournemouth).
90+5' Cauley Woodrow (Luton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Samuel Allison no option but to blow his whistle.
90+2' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
90+1' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Dominic Solanke.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Luton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
89' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) brings an opponent down and Samuel Allison interrupts the game. It's a free kick to Luton in a dangerous position.
88' It is time for a substitution. Luke Berry (Luton) is on for Ross Barkley.
88' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. Andros Townsend (Luton) replaces Chiedozie Ogbene.
88' Reece Burke (Luton) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
85' Teden Mengi (Luton) commits a rough challenge and Samuel Allison blows his whistle for a foul.

83' 4 - 3 Goal! Enes Unal displays great vision and sends a pass to Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the left post. The score is 4:3.
81' None of the Bournemouth players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
80' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

79' A sweet pass finds Enes Unal (Bournemouth) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Thomas Kaminski is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
77' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) commits a rough foul. Samuel Allison stops the game and makes a call.
76' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance.
75' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
75' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth win a corner kick.
75' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bournemouth are going to take it.
73' The referee signals a substitution. Cauley Woodrow (Luton) is brought on as a substitute for Tahith Chong.
71' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) replacing Adam Smith.
71' A rebound falls to Ross Barkley (Luton) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post.
69' Samuel Allison shows a yellow card to Adam Smith (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) comes onto the pitch for Daiki Hashioka.
66' The referee is firm and issues Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) a deserved yellow card.
64' 3 - 3 Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Thomas Kaminski with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:3.

62' 2 - 3 Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet a cross the corner kick and scores with a great header into the top right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 2:3.
61' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
59' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) commits a foul and Samuel Allison immediately signals a free kick.
58' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
55' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Tahith Chong (Luton) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Luton.
52' The ball falls kindly for Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just over the bar.
52' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Bournemouth players have a reason to celebrate!
52' Wait! Referee Samuel Allison has indicated he is going to review the Bournemouth goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

50' 1 - 3 An amazing individual effort from Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 1:3. Thomas Kaminski was helpless.
50' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
48' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Enes Unal (Bournemouth) offside.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) comes off for Marcus Tavernier.
46' Andoni Iraola has made a change at the break. Enes Unal has come on in place of Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 0 - 3 Goal - 0:3! Issa Kabore laid the ball off to Ross Barkley (Luton), who shot from close range into the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
44' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Samuel Allison blows for a foul. A free kick to Luton.
43' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
42' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
41' Samuel Allison blows for a foul after Alfie Doughty (Luton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Bournemouth have a free kick.
41' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

40' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball is out of play and Bournemouth manage to earn a corner.
40' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

39' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Thomas Kaminski and his nice save.
39' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
38' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
38' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
37' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
36' Luton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
35' Issa Kabore (Luton) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
34' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

34' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bournemouth.
34' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) steps up to send the ball in.

34' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner.
33' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

31' 0 - 2 Alfie Doughty produces a sweet pass and picks out Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:2!
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jordan Clark (Luton) was quite harsh and Samuel Allison didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
29' Issa Kabore (Luton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
27' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
27' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
26' Thomas Kaminski displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

24' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Thomas Kaminski makes a great save.
21' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Dominic Solanke.
20' 56:44 – the latest ball possession ratio.
17' Nightmare of a shot. Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is first to a rebound inside the 6-yard box but his shot goes high and wide of the goal.

16' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Thomas Kaminski makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
15' Samuel Allison blows his whistle and it's Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
15' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
14' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Bournemouth win a corner.
13' Alfie Doughty (Luton) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
13' He should have done better. Carlton Morris (Luton) is afforded space to connect with a Issa Kabore cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well wide of the right post.

9' 0 - 1 Jordan Clark sends a superb cross into the box. Tahith Chong (Luton) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the left post, leaving Neto beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 0:1.
9' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
5' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

4' Thomas Kaminski doesn't have to worry about that one. Antoine Semenyo puts a cross in towards Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the right post.
3' The ball is cleared after Carlton Morris (Luton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half has started.
Luton will kick-off.
Samuel Allison was nominated as the referee for this game.
